self: empirical evidence from any geography when its source is verifiable
structural draft of a chapter from the ratified plan
figure or chart from a dataset registered in data/ and Dodatak C with verified source and licence
citation insertion from a verified references.bib entry
coauthor: new source or bibliography addition requiring author approval
dataset licence, redistribution, or access decision not resolved in the repository
course scope, assessment, privacy, or disclosure decision
sign-off on a contested claim that repository evidence cannot resolve
note: Anything that does not require an outside decision defaults to self. Croatian evidence follows the same verification rule as evidence from any other geography. The legacy coauthor category includes any author, co-author, course-owner, licensing, access, or external decision.
